hub.title: Job boards
hub.description: Connect job boards and distribute your jobs in one go.

hero.heading: Post your job to every board at once
hero.subtitle: Connect a board, pick a job and publish — we handle distribution and keep the status in sync.

catalog.title: Available job boards
catalog.subtitle: Connect a board to start distributing jobs.

livePostings.title: Live postings
livePostings.subtitle: Your most recent postings across all boards.

empty.title: No postings yet
empty.description: Once you post a job to a board, it shows up here.

connect.boardNotFound: This job board doesn't exist or isn't available.

description.connected: Manage the connection and post a test job to this board.
description.disconnected: Connect this board to start distributing jobs.

connect.healthOk: The connection is healthy — no issues detected.

oauth.title: Connect via OAuth
oauth.description: Sign in to the board and authorize — we handle the rest.
oauth.benefit1: No copying or pasting API keys
oauth.benefit3: Post jobs and pull statuses right away

apiKey.title: Connect with an API key
apiKey.description: Paste the API key you received from the board.
apiKey.displayNamePlaceholder: E.g. our account on this board

xmlFeed.title: Connect via XML feed
xmlFeed.description: The board pulls your jobs from an XML feed URL.
xmlFeed.tip: Share this URL with the board so they can pull your jobs.
xmlFeed.warning: The board must configure this feed on their side before postings go live.

none.description: This board needs no credentials — you can connect right away.

testPosting.title: Test posting
testPosting.description: Post a single job to this board to test the connection.

disconnectDialog.title: Disconnect?
disconnectDialog.description: Are you sure you want to disconnect {{board}}? Active postings stay live, but no new ones can be posted.

connectError.title: Connection failed
connectError.description: Check your details and try again.
